feeds.title: Social Fishing
feeds.description: Social Fishing is the ultimate freshwater fishing education site. On this site, you will find the best information when it comes to freshwater fishing. With articles written by experienced anglers, fishing reports give you updates on specific areas and endless hours of video tutorials.

feeds.title: Aardvark McLeod » Freshwater fishing
feeds.description: Aardvark McLeod specializes in fly fishing holidays worldwide in saltwater and freshwater, targeting Atlantic salmon, trout, bonefish, tarpon, giant trevally. This blog gives tips and tricks about freshwater fishing.

feeds.title: Freshwater Fishing News
feeds.description: Freshwater Fishing News provides information about freshwater fishing in North America, including news, events, tips and techniques, fish identification, species overviews, and more.

feeds.title: Montreal Fishing
feeds.description: This is the official Freshwater Phil blog. Find information on freshwater sport fishing based on the personal experiences of Phil.

feeds.title: Wired2Fish
feeds.description: In February 2008, Marty and Scott Glorvigen with the help of Todd Hammill and Terry Brown launched a new fishing website, wired2fish.com, to cover the world of freshwater fishing, specifically bass fishing at the time. In the early days, most of the coverage was centered around professional fishing tournaments and bass fishing tackle which now includes fishing tips, videos, tutorials, tackle reviews & more!

feeds.title: The Fisherman » Freshwater
feeds.description: Whether you're an avid angler, a weekend fishing enthusiast, or new to fishing, it's our goal to provide you with the best fishing information available anywhere. Welcome to The Fisherman Magazine, the ultimate fishing authority in the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic regions for inshore, offshore, surf, freshwater and fly fishing. Explore more on freshwater fishing, tips for fishing and more!

feeds.title: Western Outdoor News » Freshwater Fishing
feeds.description: More than an authoritative print and online weekly outdoor publication covering one of the nation's largest markets since 1953, Western Outdoor News is also known for its storied and thrilling freshwater and saltwater events, charters and trips that activate more than 5,000 individual anglers annually throughout the West. Find more about freshwater fishing, tips, product reviews and more!

feeds.title: Carolina Sportsman » Freshwater Fishing
feeds.description: Carolina Sportsman provides hunting and fishing tips, destinations, the latest outdoor news and trends, new hunting products and fishing lures. Carolina Sportsman is the top sources for fishing and hunting information about the Carolinas. Check back often for news and great articles on the freshwater fishing here.

feeds.title: Freshwater Fishing Advice
feeds.description: I'm Eric Matechak, an avid angler & outdoorsman. I grew up fishing for anything that swims but really cut my teeth fishing for trout, chain pickerel, bass, and bullheads in my teenage years. This blog is a place where I share my freshwater fishing adventures and take my passion for fishing to a new level.

feeds.title: Fish Alaska Magazine
feeds.description: With countless miles of rivers and over 3 million lakes, Fish Alaska contributors are hard at work to cover the vast array of freshwater fisheries for readers. Fish Alaska is an Alaskan-owned & operated magazine sharing tips, how-to articles, regional features, and in-depth Alaska fishing information.

feeds.title: Guide Flyfishing Blog
feeds.description: Keep up to date with our Flyfishing Blog for more fishing tips in freshwater, product reviews and more! Guide Flyfishing proudly represents a portfolio of fly fishing's world-leading brands. We work closely with them to select, sometimes even to develop, the best possible product range both for our UK fisheries and for those travelling further afield

feeds.title: Angling Trust
feeds.description: Explore the blog of the Angling Trust Freshwater Team for all the latest news and updates, fishing tips and more! We are a not for profit organisation, representing anglers, fighting for fish, fishing and the environment. We are recognised by the Government as the National Governing Body for angling in England and partner with Visit Wales and NRW to promote Fishing in Wales. We are a member-based organisation made up of anglers of all disciplines providing a united front to represent, grow and protect our sport.
